audit.whatIsWrong: Malzahar's passive is Void Shift, not 'Void Shield' (4 fields). His R is 700 range, not 'melee-range'. Nether Grasp is a channel that Xerath's E cancels, and it cancels Xerath's R channel — neither interaction was stated. tradeBad references a dash Malzahar does not have.
audit.why: Kit file: passive 'Void Shift'; R range 700, channel flag interruptible; Xerath R channel flag interruptible; missingInteractions confirms both channel interactions.
audit.corrected: See edits: Void Shift named everywhere, R range corrected, E-cancels-his-channel and his-R-cancels-your-R both stated.

audit.why: Kit gives Nether Grasp 140/110/80s, Q 6s flat, Xerath E 13s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Malefic Visions carries an 'execute' derived flag but Riot's text describes a DoT that spreads on kill, not a threshold execute.
audit.why: Flag contradicts Riot description; trusted the description and did not write an execute claim.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 favour you cleanly: your Q out-ranges everything Malzahar has, and his only early tools are Call of the Void silence and pushing the wave. Poke him whenever he approaches a minion, but expect his Void Shield to eat your first hit — sequence W then Q so the real damage lands.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favour you cleanly: your Q out-ranges everything Malzahar has, and his only early tools are Call of the Void silence and pushing the wave. Poke him whenever he approaches a minion, but expect his Void Shift to blunt your first hit — sequence W then Q so the real damage lands.

edits.before: Through levels 3-6 you keep poking from outside his range while he perma-pushes; recognise that a shoved wave means he wants to roam or bait a dive, so ward and track his R. His level-6 Nether Grasp is the only thing that kills you, and it's melee-range, so never walk into fog and you stay ahead.
edits.after: Through levels 3-6 you keep poking from outside his range while he perma-pushes; recognise that a shoved wave means he wants to roam or bait a dive, so ward and track his R. His level-6 Nether Grasp is the only thing that kills you — 700 range, and it cancels your own R channel — so never channel or walk into fog.

edits.before: By level 3 your W-into-Q sequence beats his Void Shield and out-trades his push.
edits.after: By level 3 your W-into-Q sequence beats his Void Shift and out-trades his push.

edits.before: At first item your Q pierces his shield regen and pressures him off the wave.
edits.after: At first item your Q outpaces Void Shift's recharge and pushes him off the wave.

edits.before: Malzahar's Void Shield passive absorbs one instance of your damage, so lead with Eye of Destruction (W) or a quick Q to pop it, then land the real Arcanopulse (Q) into the exposed window. He out-pushes you with Malefic Visions and voidlings, so let the wave come to you and poke him every time he steps up to last-hit. He has no way to answer your range at this stage.
edits.after: Malzahar's Void Shift passive blunts your opening hit, so lead with Eye of Destruction (W) or a quick Q to break it, then land the real Arcanopulse (Q) into the exposed window. He out-pushes you with Malefic Visions and voidlings, so let the wave come to you and poke him every time he steps up to last-hit. He has no way to answer your range at this stage.

edits.before: Popping Void Shield with W before landing your damage Q
edits.after: Popping Void Shift with W before landing your damage Q

edits.before: His shield regenerating between your poke windows
edits.after: Void Shift recharging between your poke windows

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shocking Orb for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — 140/110/80s point-and-click suppression at 700 range. Step up only on its downtime. - Call of the Void silence is a flat 6s — poke between casts. - Budget E Shocking Orb (13s) for emergencies, the R for opportunities.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Spending E on chip and then eating Nether Grasp with nothing left to interrupt the channel — the stun is your only 'no' and he knows it.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: Your Q forces a sidestep; Eye of Destruction's slow zone covers the dodge path, so the follow-up Q lands on a slowed target.

edits.before: That’s Malzahar’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Inside 900 his Q silences you and Malefic Visions starts ticking — chip returned.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Past river his 6s Q silence and a 700-range Nether Grasp find you — a poke lead is collected from your side of the lane, not his.

edits.before: Track Malzahar’s Nether Grasp: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Nether Grasp is a channel — your Shocking Orb (E) cancels it, but only if Void Shift is already popped and your E is still in hand. It’s down or you don’t go.
